name: Vespid Dynamics Autonomous Package Delivery Drone APDD-6
product_name: Vespid Dynamics Autonomous Package Delivery Drone APDD-6
description: A cargo drone capable of autonomously delivering packages up to 5 kg across Meridian 88 using Vespid's Autonomous Navigation Mesh. The APDD-6 navigates urban airspace, avoids obstacles and other aircraft, and delivers payloads to designated GPS coordinates or directly to a recipient identified by neural interface beacon. The drone is weather-resistant, tamper-detecting, and equipped with a cargo bay that can be configured for standard packages, medical supplies, or temperature-controlled pharmaceutical transport.

specifications.recipient identification: GPS coordinates or neural interface beacon

story_hooks: APDD-6 drones have been hijacked in flight and their cargo redirected to unknown recipients — the hijacking exploits a vulnerability in the neural interface beacon system.
An APDD-6 was loaded with an explosive device instead of a package — it delivered itself to the target's door, and the tamper detection that should have flagged the payload was disabled.
